summary: The root رعب (rEb) primarily means to fear, be afraid, or be terrified, often to the utmost degree, filling one's heart with dread. It can also mean to cause fear or to threaten.
lane: 1 رَعَبَ ذ , aor. رَعَبَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. رُعْبٌ (K, TA) and رُعُبٌ , or the latter of these is a simple subst., (TA,) or each of them is a simple subst., (Msb, TA,) and the inf. n. is رَعْبٌ ; (Msb;) and رَعُبَ ; and رُعِبَ , like عُنِىَ ; both mentioned by 'Iyád and Ibn-Kurkool, and the last by ISk also; (TA;) and ; (K;) He feared; he was afraid or frightened or terrified: (Msb, K, TA:) or his bosom and heart were filled with fear: or he feared in the utmost degree; was in a state of the utmost terror. (TA.) -b2- رَعَبَ said of a valley, [like زَعَبَ ,] aor. رَعَبَ , (assumed tropical:) It became filled with water. (L.) -b3- رَعَبَتِ الحَمَامَةٌ , aor. رَعَبَ ; and , (K,) inf. n. تَرْعِيبٌ ; (A, TA;) (tropical:) The pigeon raised, and poured forth loudly, or vehemently, its cooing cry. (A, * K, TA.) You say حَمَامٌ لَهُ (tropical:) Pigeons, or a pigeon, having a loud, or vehement, cooing. (A.) -b4- And رَعَبَ , aor. رَعَبَ , [inf. n. رَعْبٌ ,] (assumed tropical:) He composed, or uttered, rhyming prose. (K.) -A2- رَعَبَهُ , (S, A, Msb, K,) aor. رُعْبٌ , (A, K,) inf. n. رَعْبٌ (A, MA) and رعّيهُ , (MA,) He caused him, or made him, to fear, or be afraid; frightened, or terrified, him: (S, A, Msb, K:) or he filled his bosom and heart with fear: or he put him in the utmost fear, or terror: (TA:) and signifies the same, (Lb, K,) inf. n. تَرْعَابٌ and ارعبهُ ; (K;) and so does , accord. to Ibn-Talhah El-Ishbeelee, and Ibn-Hishám El-Lakhmee, and Fei in the Msb; but this is disallowed by IAar and Th and J. (TA.) -b2- [Hence,] رَعْبٌ , aor. رَعَبَ , [inf. n. رَعْبٌ ,] signifies also He threatened. (K, * TA.) -b3- Also, aor. رَعَبَ , (K,) inf. n. رَعْبٌ , (TA,) He charmed, or fascinated, by magical enchantment [or by the eye ] or otherwise. (K, * TA.) -b4- Also, [like زَعَبَ ,] (S, A, Msb, K,) aor. رَعَبَ , (K,) inf. n. رَعْبٌ , (TA,) (tropical:) He filled (S, A, Msb, K) a watering-trough, or tank, (S, A,) or a vessel: (Msb:) and it (a torrent) filled a valley. (L, TA.) -A3- رَعَبَهُ , (K,) aor. رَعَبَ , (TA,) also signifies He cut it [ into pieces, or long pieces, or slices, (see تِرْعِيبَةٌ , below,)], namely, a camel's hump, or other thing; and so , (K, TA,) inf. n. تَرْعِيبٌ . (TA.) -b2- And He broke its (an arrow's) رُعْب [q. v.]. (K.)
